scope: PostgreSQL domain-over-enum ANY/ALL array parameter inference under a shadowed search_path

checks.result: 1 passed against PostgreSQL 16 via local Testcontainers

assertions: The domain-over-enum quantifier query runs inside a transaction whose search_path starts with a same-named shadow enum schema.

Both = ANY($1) and = ALL($1) retain the target enum-array parameter type and match native typed-query results and array_send bytes across ordinary, escaped, NULL, empty, multidimensional, lower-bound, and NULL-array cases.
A label that exists only in the shadow enum is refused with PostgreSQL SQLSTATE 22P02.
remaining: Other inferred PostgreSQL array function/operator contexts and the wider B3 matrix remain open.
